title: Regulatory / Compliance / Assurance Dossier
purpose: Assemble an auditable case for applicability, conformity, safety and authorization. This template does not itself certify or authorize a system.

sections.title: System Identity: Intended Use and Jurisdiction
sections.instruction: Identify system, variants, intended users, environments, deployment geography and responsible legal entity.

sections.title: Regulatory and Standards Applicability
sections.instruction: List regimes, standards, editions, jurisdiction, applicability rationale, tailoring and competent authority.

sections.title: Classification and Risk Category
sections.instruction: Record classification basis and evidence. UNKNOWN applicability or export status must remain HOLD, not ALLOW.

sections.title: Compliance Requirements Matrix
sections.instruction: Map each clause/requirement to design control, implementation, verification, evidence, status and owner.

sections.title: Safety Case
sections.instruction: Claims, arguments, hazards, controls, residual risk, evidence and acceptance authority.

sections.title: Design and Configuration Evidence
sections.instruction: Controlled drawings, software versions, component certificates, risk controls and configuration baseline.

sections.title: Test and Assessment Evidence
sections.instruction: Reports, test conditions, lab accreditation where relevant, deviations, calibration and applicability limits.

sections.title: Cybersecurity: Privacy and Data Governance
sections.instruction: Threat model, access, update, logging, data minimization, privacy zones, retention and incident handling.

sections.title: Manufacturing Quality and Traceability
sections.instruction: Quality system, production controls, supplier controls, serial traceability and change management.

sections.title: Operations: Maintenance and Post-Market Controls
sections.instruction: Instructions, training, service, monitoring, incident reporting, corrective action and recall.

sections.title: Declarations: Authorizations and Open Items
sections.instruction: Authorized declarations only; list unresolved determinations, waivers, conditions and expiry dates.

sections.title: Evidence Register and Appendices
sections.instruction: Evidence index with hashes, source, configuration, method, reviewer and status.
